metadata.scope: Normativa general para práctica de conductores particulares. Se seleccionan las preguntas 1–157 del PDF y se excluyen las 25 que incluyen gráficos. No incluye la sección específica de motos, transporte profesional, taxis y remises (158–205).
metadata.selection_note: Se amplía y reconstruye el listado completo desde la fuente. Están incluidas las 42 preguntas visibles de la conversación. No es posible identificar retrospectivamente las otras 64 supuestamente seleccionadas, ya que sus bloques no estaban disponibles. El anterior total de 106 no se usa como inventario.
metadata.numbering_note: number es consecutivo de 1 a 132 para esta compilación; source_number e id conservan la identidad original. No reemplazar ni añadir automáticamente a un banco previo sin comparar source_number y contenido.
metadata.verification_scope: Transcripción completa de los ítems seleccionados, revisión editorial, identificación de equivalencias y contraste oficial puntual de ITV, ubicación de menores y remoción por falta de licencia. No es una auditoría jurídica exhaustiva.

PAGE AND MODES
Create a compact introduction, the non-official study notice from quiz_config, a link to the official municipal source, and clear mode selection. 1. Study: prebuilt blocks of at most 20 enabled questions, optional category filtering, immediate feedback after explicit answer confirmation, reveal correct answer and a supplied explanation when present. Never invent an explanation when null: showing the correct answer is sufficient. 2. Practice simulation: choose 10, 20 or 40 questions without replacement, shuffle questions and options; show corrections only after submission. Default 20. No official approval threshold or official time limit is known: no invented pass/fail claim. Show score as correct/total and percentage, mistakes and unanswered separately. A missed or unanswered question earns zero points, no negative marking. Allow revisiting and changing answers before submitting in simulation mode. 3. Review mistakes: use saved incorrect/unanswered question IDs, deduplicate them and allow retry. Do not repeat duplicate groups in a test.

QUESTION INTERACTION
One question per card. Display Question X of Y and a progress indicator. Each option is a full-width keyboard-accessible radio control with a minimum 44px touch target, clear focus and selected states. A Confirm answer button is required in study mode; prevent multiple scoring of the same question. Previous/Next navigation must retain selections. Do not auto-advance on selection. On mobile keep the primary navigation reachable without covering options or the cookie banner. Confirm before discarding an unfinished attempt. Explicit Submit test action, with an unanswered-count notice and the ability to return. Keep feedback textual and icon-supported, not color-only; use aria-live for feedback without stealing focus. Support 320px layouts without horizontal scrolling, desktop, keyboard and screen readers.

RESULTS AND LOCAL STORAGE
Show correct, incorrect and unanswered counts; percentage; per-question review with selected and correct options; optional category breakdown when counts are meaningful; retry mistakes; new test. Save progress, results and mistake IDs locally with a versioned key (autoescuelas:cordoba-general:v1). Handle blocked/corrupt storage gracefully; the test must still work in memory. Validate saved IDs against the enabled pool when restoring, discard obsolete IDs, and provide Clear my progress. Do not send answers or personally identifying data to analytics. If the existing site has analytics, reuse its established pattern for anonymous start/completion events only.

DESIGN
